meta.title: Git operation instructions
meta.description: Save commit and PR instructions under Settings → Git. Bodies are delivered only when preparing a Git operation, never as a standing system prompt. Active, nonempty commit rules require git_workbench commits to prepare in the same turn, directory and settings revision, then draft in a new model step. No automatic writes or approval bypass. Manual Workbench, arbitrary shell/gh and Forge paths are not automatically integrated.
